share.title: FlatPack3D · KALLAX 3D assembly demo
share.description: The assembly instructions for the IKEA KALLAX shelving unit, insert with door and insert with 2 drawers, turned into an interactive step-by-step 3D demo: step animations, hardware counters, side-by-side manual pages and a line-art view.
share.imageAlt: 3D render of a KALLAX 5×5 shelving unit fitted with 5 door inserts and 5 double-drawer inserts

about.title: What is exact and what is approximate

exact.title: Exact
items: Parts, quantities, step order and hardware numbers: from the three IKEA assembly instructions (links below), checked item by item against the analysis report by scripts/validate.js.
Overall size 182 × 182 × 39 cm (width × height × depth): from the IKEA product page.

approximate.title: Approximate
approximate.intro: The assembly instructions contain no dimensions. Panel thicknesses, hole positions, insert internals and so on are estimated from the proportions of the drawings; each item below is taken directly from the guess list in data/kallax/dimensions.en.md (an English translation of the guess list in data/kallax/dimensions.md). The English part names in this interface are descriptive translations, not IKEA's official names.
approximate.heading: ## Guess list

notes: The demo runs faster than real life. Where the instructions require two people to lift or turn the unit over (shelving unit steps 23 and 24, p26; p4 also asks for two people), it must be done by two people.

source.label: KALLAX shelving unit with 10 inserts, white (IKEA Japan product page)

explainers.title: Wooden dowels and the Z-shaped hex key

items.title: Wooden dowels (shelving unit 101339 ×80, drawer insert 101345 ×4)
points: The instructions always do this in two moves: first hammer the dowels into the holes along the edge of one panel, then line the other panel's holes up with them and push it on. In the shelving unit, dowels are hammered in at steps 2, 4, 6, 9, 12, 15 and 19, and panels are pushed on at steps 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11, 13, 14, 16, 17 and 20.

In the shelving unit, the dividers are joined to the top panel, the long shelves and the bottom panel, and the long shelves are joined to the two side panels, all with dowels; only the 4 outer corners are additionally fixed with long screws.

In the double-drawer insert, step 3 hammers in 2 dowels before the sides are inserted; at the same joint, step 2 fits connecting bolts 118331 and step 4 turns the cam locks 119030 tight with a flat-blade screwdriver.

items.title: Z-shaped hex key (100001 ×1)
points: The only tool in the shelving unit hardware list (p5); both ends are hexagonal.
During assembly it is used in steps 1, 18 and 21: to drive the long countersunk hex-socket screws 104321/104322 into the 4 outer corners, 2 per corner, 8 in total.
Wall-attachment option B also uses it in steps 27 and 29 (p33, p35): first take out the 2 screws at the left end of the top panel, then put them back through the brackets.

safety.title: Safety
safety.text: The first warning in the instructions (p2): furniture that tips over can cause serious or fatal crushing injuries, so the unit must be fixed to the wall with the wall-attachment devices supplied. Screws and plugs for the wall are not included and have to be bought to suit your wall material; if you are not sure which to use, ask a professional.
safety.short: The instructions require fixing the unit to the wall to prevent tip-over. Wall screws and plugs are not included; buy them to suit your wall material.
